description.narrative: The proposed IFC investment is a financing package of up to US$170 million, comprising of (i) a quasi-equity investment of US$20 million to YCO Global Cloud Center Holdings, Inc. (the Company) and (ii) long-term senior loans of up to US$150 million to the Companys data center development pipeline. The Company is in the business of developing and operating data centers and has built a data center pipeline to be developed over next 5 years (together the Project).

This project is expected to increase access to data hosting services for businesses with the potential to grow digital services availability for individuals and enhance productivity growth for businesses. Beyond the project, this investment could improve the competitiveness of the Philippines data-hosting market resulting in a reduction of the supply gap.
